purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/singer-14t968dc.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Singer US store page, SKU 14T968DC.BR, 'Sold and Shipped by: Singer'. Specification block, FAQ, warranty summary and Bazaarvoice reviews (4.3 from 62).

74 pages, text layer parsed. Linked from the maker page as 'View SINGER Professional 5 14T968DC Manual' (the link returns an HTML viewer; the PDF is at the /content/ path). Copyright line 2008. Specification table on p72.
SVP Worldwide Limited Warranty (US and Canada), 3 pages. Generic 25 year / 2 year / 90 day document, not model-specific.

facts.value: Page: 'Warranty (90 day / 2yr / 25yr)'. Warranty PDF: 25 years on the product frame (free replacement parts, owner pays shipping and labor); 2 years on electronic and electrical parts (repair or replace, owner pays shipping and labor); 90 days on mechanical parts and adjustments. Household (non-commercial) use only.
facts.spec_value: 25 yr frame, 2 yr electronic and electrical, 90 days mechanical parts and adjustments
facts.note: The warranty PDF is the generic SVP Worldwide document, not model-specific. It is made only to the first purchaser from Singer or an authorized Singer dealer, and Singer 'reserves the right to reject warranty claims' for products from unauthorized dealers, including unauthorized internet sites. Not transferable to later owners.

facts.value: General purpose foot, screwdrivers, clean pocket, extra knife, spool caps, anti-spill thread nets, oiler, brush, tweezers, needles, cone adapters, soft dust cover ('$100 value')
facts.spec_value: General purpose foot; spreader; spare knife; screwdrivers; spool caps; thread nets; oiler and brush; tweezers; needles; cone adapters; soft dust cover
facts.note: The page list has no 'spreader' line and calls the trim trap a 'Clean Pocket'. The page FAQ does mention a spreader. The manual (section 19) shows converting the upper looper to a spreader, which suggests the spreader is a convertible part rather than a separate accessory: not confirmed.

facts.value: Manual lists section 23 'How to Sew a Cover Stitch' with a clutch (L / C driving clutch) and cover-stitch needles (left Orange, middle Blue, right Green). Page: 'Built-In Rolled Hem: just slide a lever ... no need to change stitch plate'.
facts.note: The manual shows a clutch change and needle changes for cover stitch. We did not extract the step count or times from the manual, so no changeover time is stated. The page mentions the lever for rolled hem only.

facts.value: Manual: 'When using the Auto Tension Dial (ATD), the correct tension is set automatically.' Auto tension settings are based on medium weight fabric and standard 60 polyester spun thread; if results differ, adjust tension in small increments. A dial setting (A to E in the examples) is chosen per stitch.
facts.note: The page says the machine adjusts tensions for the selected stitch automatically. The manual shows a user-set dial position per stitch, so 'self-adjusting' is a dial-assisted preset, not a sensor system. Stated as the maker's wording only.

'Self-Adjusting Tensions System ... fully automatic ... ensures that every stitch remains balanced and even'; 'Heavy Duty Metal Frame'; 'High Speed Stitching (1300/min) Professional speed'; FAQ: 'powerful motor, making it ideal for sewing through multiple layers of thick fabrics like denim and canvas'; meta description 'couture-quality construction'; 'Professional 5' series name
facts.note: All maker claims (rule 7). 'Heavy Duty' and 'Finishing Touch' are Singer series names; 'Professional 5' is a series name and the '5' is the thread capability. Our spec's claim 'Designed for both home and professional use' was not found on the page fetched 2026-10-02.
